CREATE TABLE producers (

    country           TEXT NOT NULL,
    region            TEXT,

);

CREATE TABLE wines (
    wine_id      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    producer_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    wine_name    TEXT NOT NULL,
    varietal     TEXT,
    vintage      INTEGER,        -- NULL for non-vintage
    color        TEXT NOT NULL,  -- Red, White, Rose, Sparkling

    FOREIGN KEY (producer_id) REFERENCES producers(producer_id)
);

    customer_id    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    business_name  TEXT NOT NULL,
    customer_type  TEXT NOT NULL,  -- Restaurant, Retail Shop, Bar, Hotel
    city           TEXT,
    state          TEXT,
    account_opened TEXT,           -- ISO date
    credit_limit   REAL
);

CREATE TABLE orders (
    order_id    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    order_date  TEXT NOT NULL,   -- ISO date
    ship_date   TEXT,            -- ISO date, NULL if not shipped
    status      TEXT NOT NULL,   -- Delivered, Shipped, Pending, Cancelled
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(customer_id)
);

CREATE TABLE order_items (
    item_id      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    wine_id      INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantity     INTEGER NOT NULL,  -- bottles
    unit_price   REAL NOT NULL,     -- price charged per bottle
    discount_pct REAL,              -- NULL = no discount
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(order_id),

);

PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;

CREATE TABLE vessels (
    vessel_id      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name           TEXT NOT NULL,
    vessel_type    TEXT NOT NULL,
    home_port      TEXT NOT NULL,
    length_m       REAL,
    gross_tonnage  INTEGER,
    year_built     INTEGER,
    status         TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE captains (
    captain_id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name         TEXT NOT NULL,
    license_number    TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    hire_date         TEXT NOT NULL,
    years_experience  INTEGER,
    phone             TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE trips (
    trip_id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    vessel_id       INTEGER NOT NULL,
    captain_id      INTEGER NOT NULL,
    departure_date  TEXT NOT NULL,
    return_date     TEXT,
    fishing_area    TEXT NOT NULL,
    fuel_liters     INTEGER,
    crew_size       INTEGER,
    FOREIGN KEY (vessel_id) REFERENCES vessels(vessel_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (captain_id) REFERENCES captains(captain_id)
);

CREATE TABLE catches (
    catch_id      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    trip_id       INTEGER NOT NULL,
    species       TEXT NOT NULL,
    weight_kg     REAL NOT NULL,
    price_per_kg  REAL,
    grade         TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (trip_id) REFERENCES trips(trip_id)
);
